name: connors_rsi_extreme_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the Connors RSI composite (averaging RSI(6) of the last 30-second price move, RSI(2) of the consecutive-bar streak, and 100-bar percentile rank of 5-second returns) drops below 10, three independent exhaustion signals converge simultaneously: the 30-second price RSI is deeply oversold, the streak of consecutive down-closes has worsened, and the current bar's return sits in the bottom percentile of the recent intraday distribution. At this confluence, VWAP-benchmarked institutional programs on NIFTY — which benchmark against the current session average — treat sub-VWAP prices at this extreme CRSI depth as below-benchmark accumulation opportunities, initiating buy-side absorption within 15-30 seconds. We enter on the turning bar where CRSI first crosses back above the oversold threshold, confirming the exhaustion is complete rather than catching a falling knife.

indicators.name: rsi_6
indicators.purpose: 30-second price RSI (6 bars × 5s). Original uses RSI(3) on 1-min bars = 3-minute lookback. We compress to 30 seconds because we hold 15-90s, not 10-45 min. The fast RSI component needs to detect selling exhaustion at the timescale of our trade, not the original's. 3-bar RSI on 5s would be 15s — too twitchy for index-level signal. 6-bar (30s) balances responsiveness with stability on NIFTY.

indicators.name: streak
indicators.purpose: Counts consecutive up (positive) or down (negative) closes with no lookback. Directly applicable to 5s bars — at 5s resolution, NIFTY naturally accumulates streaks of 3-8 consecutive same-direction closes during momentum moves. A streak of -5 or worse on 5s bars (25 seconds of consecutive down-closes) indicates persistent sell flow.

indicators.name: streak_rsi_2
indicators.purpose: RSI(2) of the streak series. Same lookback as original (2 bars). At 5s, 2 bars = 10 seconds. This component measures whether the streak is worsening or starting to improve — a streak RSI rising from a low reading indicates the streak is recovering even if still negative. Tiny lookback is intentional: this is meant to be a turning-point detector, not a trend measure.

indicators.name: pct_rank_100
indicators.purpose: Percentile rank of the current 5-second return within the last 100 bars (8.3 minutes of intraday history). Original uses 100 1-min bars = 100 minutes. We keep 100 bars but in 5s = 8.3 min. This is deliberate: at 5s resolution, 8 minutes of 5s returns gives a rich enough distribution (~100 observations) to rank the current bar's return. Going longer risks mixing different intraday regimes; shorter gives too few observations for a meaningful percentile.

indicators.name: crsi
indicators.purpose: Connors RSI composite. Ranges 0-100. Below 10 = extreme oversold (all three components simultaneously at extremes). Above 90 = extreme overbought. The crossing of 10 from below serves as the entry trigger.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as proximity anchor. No scaling needed — cumulative from daily open. We require price to be within 0.3% of VWAP for both long and short to ensure we're trading near the institutional benchmark, not chasing extreme deviations where the bounce horizon is longer than our 90s hold.

conditions: crsi crossed above crsi_oversold threshold (prev bar crsi < threshold, current bar crsi >= threshold)
close < vwap (price still below benchmark — institutional demand incoming)
close > vwap * (1 - vwap_band_pct) (within band — not a runaway selloff)
buy_ce.confirmation: CRSI crossing back above oversold threshold confirms exhaustion complete — same principle as original's 'crsi rises above 10 on next bar' but tightened to an actual cross rather than any rise

conditions: crsi crossed below crsi_overbought threshold (prev bar crsi > threshold, current bar crsi <= threshold)
close < vwap * (1 + vwap_band_pct) (within band — not a runaway rally)
buy_pe.confirmation: CRSI crossing back below overbought threshold confirms upside exhaustion

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (≈8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). A CRSI extreme reversion should not retrace more than 8 spot points within the first 30s if buying pressure is genuinely absorbing. If NIFTY drops 8 more spot points after our entry, the institutional buy flow has not materialized and the thesis is invalidated. Calibrated to the lower end of 30-60s NIFTY typical moves (2-5 option pts) with a modest R buffer.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points (≈12 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). CRSI extreme reversals on NIFTY typically produce a 10-15 spot point bounce to VWAP within 60-90 seconds. 6 option pts captures roughly 50-60% of this expected bounce (1:1.5 R:R), exiting before the move stalls at VWAP resistance.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — above 22 NIFTY moves become gappy and the 90s hold assumption breaks down
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 min (pre-open noise) and last 10 min (illiquid options)
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is always sufficient
filters.trend_filter: VWAP proximity band implicitly filters — requires price within 0.3% of VWAP
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — Connors RSI is published and understood, but the 5s index adaptation with VWAP proximity filter is less commonly implemented at this frequency

adaptation_notes: Original was a stock-universe strategy (NIFTY 100 F&O stocks) holding 10-45 min on 1-min bars. Key changes: (1) Universe → single NIFTY index. (2) RSI period compressed from 3 min to 30s (6 bars) to match our 15-90s hold — original was catching 3-min exhaustions, we catch 30-second exhaustions. (3) Percentile rank kept at 100 bars but in 5s = 8.3 min (original = 100 min) — this is appropriate for the intraday distribution at this timescale. (4) Entry changed from 'CRSI < 10 setup then confirmation on next bar' to an actual CRSI cross above/below threshold — cleaner and more directly computable on arrays. (5) Stop/target converted from percentage of entry price to option premium points: original 0.35% stop ≈ 77 spot pts on NIFTY at 22000, far too wide for a 90s hold. Calibrated to 4/6 option pts based on typical 30-60s NIFTY moves.
weaknesses: CRSI on 5-second NIFTY bars may fire too frequently — the 3-bar RSI component oscillates at sub-1-minute scale and can produce spurious extremes during fast trending moves
VWAP proximity band (0.3%) on NIFTY ≈ 66 pts: during high-volatility sessions NIFTY may gap through this band without a genuine reversal opportunity
Streak component at 5s resolution may accumulate negative streaks of only 2-3 bars before reversing, making the streak RSI component less informative than on 1-min bars
